decisions.statement: A route opens only to a person with an access naming the route.
An access stating `all` names every route.
Only an access of the route kind opens a route.
An access is asked for by the addresses its person and its kind are named by.
An account read to no person reaches no route.
A grant is read from the access pages rather than compiled in.
Access pages that went unread open nothing.
A decision carries why the decision refused.

definition: whether the person an account represents may reach a route
